basis.design_speed: User-specified design condition, not measured vessel performance
basis.mass_inertia: CAD-based baseline estimate plus explicit battery/motor/propeller proxies, parallel-axis combination and solved hydrostatics
basis.drag_uncertainty: Engineering sensitivity bracket +/-25%, not a statistical confidence interval
basis.environment: Bounded algorithm-test cases, not a certified sea-state operating envelope
basis.propulsion: Power-constrained engineering thrust/RPM/advance proxy; same equations in every scenario
basis.fidelity: Rigid body, sealed hull, distributed wave pressure and deep-water orbital flow, quasi-static tank, lumped energy; no claim of CFD, cavitation, planing, structural damage or liquid slosh
